name: go-mcxboxbroadcast
author: hashim@lunarbedrock.com
description: Publishes a Minecraft: Bedrock Edition server as an Xbox Live friend-list world and relays joining clients to the configured Bedrock server's NetherNet HTTP signaling.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
set -eu

cd /mnt/server
mkdir -p cache

# Emit a single-quoted YAML scalar so panel text cannot break the document.
yaml_string() {
    printf "'%s'" "$(printf '%s' "$1" | tr '\r\n' '  ' | sed "s/'/''/g")"
}

if [ ! -f config.yml ]; then
    cat > config.yml <<EOF
configVersion: 7
debugMode: ${DEBUG_MODE}
suppressSessionUpdateMessage: false

http:
  proxy: ""

session:
  joinUrl: $(yaml_string "${JOIN_URL}")
  updateInterval: 30
  queryServer: ${QUERY_SERVER}
  webQueryFallback: false
  configFallback: ${CONFIG_FALLBACK}
  broadcastSetting: 3
  worldType: Survival
  hideOldSessions: true
  sessionInfo:
    hostName: $(yaml_string "${HOST_NAME}")
    worldName: $(yaml_string "${WORLD_NAME}")
    players: 0
    maxPlayers: ${MAX_PLAYERS}

friendSync:
  updateInterval: 60
  autoFriend: true
  initialInvite: true
  expiry:
    enabled: true
    days: 15
    check: 1800
    historyPath: cache/player_history.json

notifications:
  enabled: ${NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED}
  webhookUrl: $(yaml_string "${WEBHOOK_URL}")

gallery:
  enabled: ${GALLERY_ENABLED}
  imagePath: $(yaml_string "${GALLERY_IMAGE_PATH}")
  deleteOtherImages: true

accounts:
  primaryCachePath: cache/live_token.json
EOF
fi

echo "go-mcxboxbroadcast configuration is ready. Start the server and complete the Microsoft device-code sign-in shown in the console."

variables.name: Join URL
variables.description: NetherNet HTTP signaling URL of the Bedrock server players join, such as https://play.example.net:19132.

variables.name: Host Name
variables.description: Server name shown in the Minecraft friend-list world.

variables.name: World Name
variables.description: World name shown in the Minecraft friend-list world.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Displayed max player count when the target server is not queried.

variables.name: Query Target Server
variables.description: Whether to query the target Bedrock server for live displayed status.

variables.name: Use Config Fallback
variables.description: Whether failed target queries should reset displayed status to configured values.

variables.name: Notifications Enabled
variables.description: Enable Slack or Discord-compatible webhook notifications.

variables.name: Webhook URL
variables.description: Slack or Discord-compatible webhook URL for notifications and headless sign-in prompts.

variables.name: Gallery Enabled
variables.description: Enable Minecraft profile showcase image upload.

variables.name: Gallery Image Path
variables.description: Path to the showcase image inside the server files.
